name: Basic Cray
imitates: A generic crayfish tied for carp but good anywhere crayfish are a food source; bead-chain eyes tip it over to ride hook point up.
recipe: Crusty Nail Fusion Dub mixed with Red Ice Dub

steps.text: Lay a thick thread base, stopping about four wraps behind the hook eye.
Mount the bead chain eyes with X wraps and a few wraps under them so they do not twist, then wrap back to the barb.
Clean the underfur from a clump of squirrel tail and tie it in on the far side near the bend as one claw.
Tie in a second clump on the opposite side so the two claws splay off the back of the hook.
Tie in the copper wire and the Scud Back at the rear, then blend the two dubbings about 3 parts Crusty Nail to 1 part Red Ice Dub.
Dub the body forward to the eyes, then use the dubbed thread in X wraps around the eyes to cover the bare thread.
Pull the Scud Back forward over the top and tie it off behind the hook eye. Wrap the wire forward to rib it and tie off.
Whip finish, then pick out the dubbing on top with a bodkin or brush to look like a curled crayfish tail.
Finished Basic Cray: squirrel-tail claws, segmented orange-red body and bead chain eyes.
